decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The site shall only be used as a Residential Children’s Care Home and not for any other uses falling within Use Class (C2), or for any other purposes, unless an alternative use is agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

The new Residential Care Home hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than 3.no children (aged 7 to 18) and 2.no members of staff at any given time (unless any substantive changes are otherwise agreed in writing with the LPA).
description: Change of Use: Residential dwelling (Class C3) to therapeutic residential children's care home for up to three children aged 7 to 18  (Class C2)

phasing_details.phase_detail: This is just for change of use, there are no works to be carried out
